method: librosa 0.11 + demucs htdemucs 4-stem separation (drums/bass/vocals/other). kick = 30-130 Hz flux of drum stem, snare/clap = 1.2-6 kHz flux of drum stem, hat = 7-11 kHz; vocal/bass/other = onset_strength of each stem; peak-picked, attack refined to steepest 2 ms RMS rise. Beat grid: brute-force BPM/phase fit maximizing drum-stem onset strength on an 8th grid. Sections: bar-level 16-step onset maps per stem (see analysis-notes.md) + RMS + recurrence novelty, labelled by structure.
